texts: Calcineurin inhibitors block IL-2 production by activated T cells: D.
Cyclosporine, bound to cyclophilin, and tacrolimus, bound to FKBP-12, inhibit calcineurin, so the transcription factor NFAT is not activated, IL-2 is not made and T cells do not proliferate.

TOR inhibitors such as sirolimus arrest the cell cycle in G1, antimetabolites such as azathioprine and mycophenolate block purine synthesis, basiliximab is an antibody to the IL-2 receptor, and steroids block cytokine production broadly.
In the picture, the cyclone-taco silences the bugler's call, so the ants never rally.
Memory hook: the taco storm blows out the IL-2 bugle.
